## From the manufacturer

### Ultimate JBL Sound

The compact JBL Go 3 packs quite a punch when it comes to its crystal-clear sound. Enjoy signature JBL bass at 4.2W RMS without any distortion, no matter the audio range.

### Mega Playtime and Quick Pairing

Experiencing a lag between your audio and video is such a buzzkill. Say goodbye to latency with Go 3's latest Bluetooth 5.1. Packed with a Li-ion polymer 2.775Wh battery, the Go 3 sure has power double its size. Charge it just once and enjoy a whopping battery backup of 5 hours.

### IP67 Water-Resistant and Dust-Resistant

The sleek Go 3 is designed to fit the versatile lifestyle of millennials. Be it a day out at the beach or the pool, the speaker's IP67 water and dust-resistant technology makes sure you set the vibe anywhere.

### Edgy Design, Ultra Portable

Fusing the best of style and substance, the Go 3 makes its mark with its edgy design, colorful fabrics, and expressive details. The eye-catching JBL embossing makes a statement even before the beats drop. Weighing at just 0.209kg and with a sleek dimension of 3.4" x 2.7" x 1.6", the JBL Go 3 with its fabric handle fits right in your hands. Take it everywhere, hang it anywhere.

* Ayush Dey

  *4 out of 5 stars*

  ##### Review after 1yr of heavy usage

  Reviewed in India on 21 January 2026

  Colour: BlueStyle Name: Go 3

  Verified Purchase

  Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

  Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

  0:00

  My honest review after 1 year of heavy use

  I have been using the JBL Go 3 heavily for over a year now, and overall, I think it is a solid choice, but there are a few things you should know before buying.

  The Sound Quality

  For a small speaker, the audio is actually really pleasant. The highs and mids are crystal clear. The bass is good and feels balanced, but only up to 70-80% volume. That is the "sweet spot."

  If you push the volume above 80%, the bass gets compressed and basically disappears. At max volume, you will mostly just hear vocals and treble, so it’s better to keep it a bit lower for the best experience.

  Battery

  The battery backup is very decent. For its size, it lasts a good amount of time even with daily use.

  Build Quality Issue

  The speaker feels sturdy, but I had one specific issue: the rubber grip at the bottom (where you place it down) eventually ripped off. You have to be extra careful about how you handle it and where you keep it, otherwise, the rubber strip might peel away like mine did.

  Verdict

  It’s a great little speaker with clear sound, as long as you don't blast it at full volume and are careful with the bottom grip.

  Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

  The sound quality in such form factor is amazing. To top it up, the design is excellent. It has really good bass, no distortion even at max volume. If the speaker is kept flat on surface, it starts moving because of bass and light weight. The led indicator blinks red in low charge, stays red during charging and turns off after full charge. Charging time is long, approx 3 hours. It doesn't show accurate battery percentage in phone so just guess work, should be around 7-8 hours in 50 percent volume . Bluetooth range is really good. There is no app support so no customisation option. Got it for 2k, definitely value for money at this range considering the size and excellent sound quality. The loop adds it to the already compact size, easy to carry in jacket pockets.

  1) Bluetooth connectivity - It's superfast⚡. You don't have to manually press the bluetooth button on the speaker if you wanna connect the same last connected device. Just pressing the power ON button of the speaker does the job.

  2)Charging - It's sufficient for a light day to day usage. Battery gets charged quickly . I don't have to worry about charging it constantly. I don't charge it for days since I'm a light user.

  3)Design - I like the design. Rugged design makes me worry a bit less about its protection.

  4)Size -it's so compact and cute 🥺❤️I love it!

  5) Sound - Bass is good. You can feel the vibration. The speaker sounds good in a 50-80% range but after a certain volume or at max volume, the sound loses the clarity and doesn't feel good to listen. I don't like it at full volume. I can manage it without full volume bcz it's near me mostly. So, I don't have any issues regarding that.

  6) Loudness- I think it's loud enough at full volume but I don't think charge will retain at such a volume. But it's loud!

  It's also good for people who like music in their bathtime. You don't have to worry about network issues of your phone in there anymore when you have this bluetooth speaker. 🚿😁✨
